web-guide-idea-32.audience: Learners who know some English but hesitate to speak.
web-guide-idea-32.offer: Sell practice time with patient corrections, not a promise of instant fluency. Choose one everyday situation so the learner leaves with something usable.
web-guide-idea-32.steps.0: Ask about level and choose a situation such as ordering food.
web-guide-idea-32.steps.1: Role-play it, then repeat with gentle corrections.
web-guide-idea-32.steps.2: Recap a few useful phrases and a small practice task.
web-guide-idea-32.equipment: A phone, earphones and a notebook. A simple shared document is optional.
web-guide-idea-32.returnReason: Offer a sequence of everyday situations and show progress through repeated practice.
web-guide-idea-32.promotion: Share an example of a gentle correction and state the level and language support you can provide.

web-guide-idea-32.metadataDescription: Help someone practise everyday English at their pace, using real conversations and gentle feedback. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
